stories.headline: SpaceX is raising $40B to buy Nvidia chips for AI
stories.blurb: SpaceX is pursuing a massive $40 billion debt deal to purchase Nvidia chips, marking one of the largest infrastructure investments in AI to date. The funding underscores how even non-AI-native companies are now pouring billions into compute hardware to compete in the AI race.
stories.why_it_matters: Even rocket companies now need data center-scale AI infrastructure to stay competitive.
stories.original_headline: SpaceX looks to raise $40bn to buy Nvidia chips

stories.headline: Lambda raises $4B to build GPU clouds before going public
stories.blurb: Nvidia-backed Lambda is raising up to $4 billion at a $14.5 billion valuation, led by Coatue and Blackstone, ahead of a planned 2027 IPO. The startup rents out GPU clusters to companies training and running AI models.
stories.why_it_matters: Another sign that picks-and-shovels infrastructure for AI is still a bet investors will write giant checks for.
stories.original_headline: AI computing startup Lambda to raise $4B ahead of planned IPO

stories.headline: Google open-sourced a tiny model that turns images and text into searchable vectors
stories.blurb: DeepMind released EmbeddingGemma 2, a 300-million-parameter model that converts images and text into numerical representations for search and retrieval. It runs locally on a laptop, handles 20+ languages, and outperforms larger competitors on multilingual benchmarks while using a fraction of the compute.
stories.why_it_matters: Developers can now build search and recommendation features that run on-device without sending data to the cloud.
stories.original_headline: EmbeddingGemma 2: an open, lightweight multimodal embedding model

stories.headline: Google just launched an AI that generates playable games from text prompts
stories.blurb: Playground is a new experimental platform where you describe a game idea in plain language and AI builds it instantly — think 'a platformer where you're a cat collecting fish' or 'Pong but the paddles are pizzas.' You can play immediately, then tweak the rules or visuals with more prompts.
stories.why_it_matters: Game creation without code just became conversational — anyone can prototype ideas in seconds.
stories.original_headline: Introducing Playground: Create and play custom games

try_this_prompt.title: The hiring red-flag translator
try_this_prompt.prompt: I just finished interviewing a candidate and something felt off, but I can't put my finger on it. I'll describe what they said and how they said it. Tell me: what my gut is actually reacting to, whether it's a real concern or just difference in style, and the one follow-up question that would confirm or dismiss it.
try_this_prompt.tool_hint: Right after the interview, before you talk yourself into ignoring your instinct.
